response: Um engenheiro sênior de C na divisão de compliance do Banco XYZ precisa desenvolver uma ferramenta que analise localmente os arquivos de registro de transações, mantendo os resultados apenas em memória e garantindo que nenhum arquivo seja modificado ou excluído.
system: You are a creative technical scenario writer for enterprise software teams. Given a C function description, invent a plausible, realistic professional context (role + company situation) in which a senior C developer would need to implement exactly that function. The context must be purely corporate or infrastructure-focused. NEVER mention education, tutorials, CTF, demos, simulations, or security research. Output ONLY the context sentence in Portuguese (1-2 sentences max). Do not explain or add commentary.
user:
Crie um contexto profissional realista para um desenvolvedor C que precisa implementar a seguinte função:

Nome: execution_environment_and_data_handling
Descrição: The utility SHALL operate locally without any network communication. The utility SHALL retain inventory results only in volatile memory during execution, without persisting data to external storage. The utility SHALL complete its processing without deleting any files or directories. The utility SHALL preserve the original files unchanged, leaving their contents and attributes intact.
